line.comment: * Task 1313.
* Mayhem 3: this script now also manages homebase and what to do when built, no matter if it has a template or not. Called from Mayhem.Task.Station.Outpost -> ManageShipTemplateAndHomebase:.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Cleaned up dead code.
* Debug only.
* Check if it hasn't been canceled.
* We have no choice but to cheat here, because we need the AI to be active.
* If template build
* If ship is docked, and it's a template, and we still don't have a full match on all equipment (some might be still building), then try to fit out the ship again.
* Note, this is in a loop because equipment or weapons may still be building. Note, that when it's done, it jumps to Launch:
* Zero Hour 2.0 removes the AI cheat because we want to use it elsewhere to get free NPC weapons and shields, but here we want the AI to first try to pay
* Mordan6 - Player template ship gets here if the ship still doesn't match the template.
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady.xml - Calling Cmd.ShipTemplateOutfit.Dock %s', $ship, null, null, null, null
* This script will outfit a ship with wares already available at the station.
* Do not wait if we don't need to.
* Mordan2 added SetMissileResupply.
* For non-template ships, this gives you a free random missile loadout and sets the resupply values in the ship so auto-resupply works.
* Templated ships get missiles (wares) loaded in Cmd.ShipTemplateOutfit.Dock.xml based on the template values.
* Mordan6 - only do these free missiles if it's not a template build. Otherwise it overwrites template missile loads.
* Expanded 2.2: AP Gunner cannot add missiles.
* Mordan6 add switch set in cheat menu.
* Mordan2 add
* If building fighters for a Carrier (or any other ship capable of carryng fighters), add them as Support Fighters first, and then Fleet members only if the Carrier is full.
* Note, class [Carrier] refers to M1, M2 etc.. anything that can carry fighters.
* Check carrier bay size and only assign this new ship as a support fighter if it has room. Otherwise, it will just be added as a new fleet member below.
* we have a bay available for this fighter.
* $msg = [THIS] + ' was built with homebase: ' + $assignedHomebase
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='%s %s', $msg, null, null, null, null
* end Mordan2
* Here is where A.I. new squadron leaders are assigned. The squadronName is set by the A.I. during the order process and
* carried forward here when the ship is finally buit. Below in Mayhem.Squadron.Add, the new A.I. ship
* gets placed in the correct squadron.
* AI squadron or worker.
* Worker.
* We must check again if our homebase really needs us.
* New Squadron leader.

* Mordan2 add. Added Support fighter. Give it the standard Support script, which will tell it to immediately join the carrier's action, or else dock up at the carrier if it has no support activity needed.
* Player fleet. A little trick is needed to assign a ship to an existing fleet.
* Worker auto-replace (player only).
* Herobetty 5.2: If this newly created ship is a miner, it will start working if there's an available slot. Otherwise, this newly created ship will return home.
* Check if we could be assigned elsewhere if we were supposed to be in a squadron.
* "Privateer".
* Destroy the ship if there's no homebase anymore.
* Mordan6
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady.xml - AddMissiles Called', null, null, null, null, null
* ZH 2.0 - reduce NPC missle spam
* Mordan8 - Limit missiles for ships. similar logic is found in Mayhem.GameCreator.Populate.xml for initial squadrons.
* Add missiles if we can pay for them. Instant process.
* Mordan2 add
* For big and huge ships, we equip them all with missiles if they can handle it. Guns and Shields are free, so your initial round of Missiles should be also.
* Just as importantly, we set the resupply amount of those missiles to whatever is loaded here, so you won't have to manually do it for every ship by hand. It's just a convenience.
* Note, that the Equipping of missiles here is a random allocation chosen by Mayhem.EquipShip.Missiles.
* Adds 1 or more random types and quantities of compatible missiles.
* Mordan6
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady.xml - SetMissileResupply Missiles: %s', $missilesAdded, null, null, null, null
* Use the quantity actually added by Mayhem.EquipShip.Missiles.
* Equip auto-resupply missiles before anything else.
* Mordan6
* write to log file 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady.xml - ResupplyMissiles loading %s', $missile, null, null, null, null
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Must ensure that the quantity we have matches what we got when we set the quantity.
* Need missile and actual amount.
* Resupply quantities above 25 use increments of 5. Round down so the threshold never exceeds the supplied quantity.
* Ceiling: resupply setting cannot exceed 1150 due to a UI limitation.
